sortieLines.line: ⚔️ SORTIE — Patricia, Natalia, Naran take up arms and a day's rations (6,000 kcal from the stores) and walk out to the treeline. Nobody's coming back the same.
The treeline is quiet. No shapes in the dark.
The village is rattled. Everyone's jumpy — eyes on the treeline.
The village is rattled. Everyone's jumpy — eyes on the treeline.
The Reunion stops at the treeline — pacing, unwilling. The walls end the argument. It's still out there.
⚔️ SORTIE — Zoltan, Heloísa, Quinn take up arms and a day's rations (6,175 kcal from the stores) and walk out to the treeline. Nobody's coming back the same.
⚔️ Zoltan faced The Reunion at the treeline... and didn't come back. The party carries the body home. The sortie is over.

🌙 Night. The lingering The Reunion gorges at the treeline — 600 kcal gone from the stores. Endure it (they drift off within ~6 nights — the gorge is the price), or send a sortie: fighters, rations, real risk.

🌙 Night. The lingering Chorus Line gorges at the treeline — 1,400 kcal gone from the stores. Endure it (they drift off within ~6 nights — the gorge is the price), or send a sortie: fighters, rations, real risk.
Ella came back from the treeline white-faced. Saw it too. Whatever it is, it's still out there.
The village is rattled. Everyone's jumpy — eyes on the treeline.
The village is rattled. Everyone's jumpy — eyes on the treeline.
Nothing holds the treeline. (No lingerers to sortie against.)
Night. The treeline is just a sound now. The fire is the whole argument against it.
Not enough fighters to send — a sortie needs at least two besides you, and the bench is bare. (Endure it, or call for help.)
